title: Unleashing the Power of J35™Pro 3D Printer with Stratasys' PolyJet™Technology
summary: In this video, we explore some of the unique features and benefits of the J35 Pro when compared to Desktop resin printers, including time-to-part, parts accuracy, ease of use and cost of ownership.
